publication issues.summary: AP371 private partial reconstruction. Baseline conversion blocked at BJ.inputAW; five logical target references were associated to existing BJ inputs using existing net-owned routes. Two short printed 6/L leads and native gaps remain uncertain. No physical pin identity, new wire or electrical join is inferred. The exact raw inverse and byte-identical text were checked. Candidate conversion exits 0 with 45 unresolved render differences (36 wire glyphs); 34 are at UNUSED row 16, six concern printed 2 on rows 63/70/77, four printed 6/L on rows 67/74, and one footer cell. Preserve these as unresolved. Native overview, selected native tiles, flagged regions and all 29 junction/56 crossing local panels were visually inspected. Geometry maps to 25 overlapping sections, but no complete end-to-end electrical or omission proof is claimed. Box registration has 64/68 inliers and median 2.21 render pixels; independent edge 27/31, median 1.67, with nine-point maximum disagreement 27.12 pixels. These are global fits, not evidence of no local distortion. Candidate and review are unapproved; no canonical source, key or publication changed. Native, source, electrical, full trace and omission claims remain bounded by source review. Current selected json differs from candidate source; historical mismatch retained. The candidate source does not fully match the previous local selection: model match False, text match True. The previous selection is preserved in the publication receipt.
